supplemental_items.interpretation: E enabled requires non-null E engine and exact enabled S option. StopAll additionally requires non-null explicit lifecycle_engine, evaluated first. Primary version uses non-null engine test, E version uses truthiness (distinct from E enable test), StopAll version uses explicit lifecycle option non-null independently of S/E enable gates. Blue/A/S flags compare exact enabled strings. actualFrom/To use visible start/end main candle timestamps converted with epoch. Initialize directions empty, assert dict, then build outputs in state.directions encounter order with shared state and timings; repeated direction overwrites its previous key. No price rounding in envelope.
